evening.definition: The part of the day after the afternoon. The light gets soft and people come home.

hidden.definition: Kept out of sight, so that people walk past without noticing.
hidden.example: The door was hidden under the ivy.

severance.definition: A payment made to an employee when a job ends, often calculated by years of service.
severance.example: The package included three months of salary as severance.

steelman.definition: Giving the other side's position its strongest and most honest form before you argue against it.
steelman.example: Before you answer, steelman the other view in one sentence and see if it still convinces you.
